title: StartSound2 (tag 89) missing — named sound class events broken
description: Tag 89 (StartSound2) is absent from tags.ts and the compile path. All frame-sound emission uses StartSound (tag 15, by charId). StartSound2 triggers a sound by its linkage class name rather than character ID and is needed for attachSound/sound class linkage. Add tag 89 to tags.ts and add emission in compile.ts alongside StartSound.
